# Build your own robot lawn mower: open-source, wire-free, fully designed

> Build your own robot lawn mower. An open-source robotic mower with wire-free RTK GNSS navigation, a guarded pivoting-blade disc, a floating bump shell, ESP32 safety firmware and a complete CAD manufacturing package (MIT). Plan your own lawn's mowing pattern in the browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
